description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart summarizing the distribution of “Stimulus Type” categories used in the referenced study, and it contains 10 slices. The chart places the title “Stimulus Type” in the center, uses external text labels with percentages (not printed inside slices), shows no visible legend, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized; the slices appear arranged around the circle without an explicitly stated ordering.
